paginas.texto: Luna is a husky. She is loyal, she is loud, and on Thursday she opened the garden gate with her nose.
Valentina looked in the classroom. No Luna. Only a chair and somebody's sandwich.
Mateo looked in the library. No Luna. But he found the book he lost last year.
Sofia looked at the map and asked one question: 'Where does Luna always want to go?'
Everybody said it at the same time: 'THE FARM.' Luna loves the cows and the cows do not love Luna.
They ran down the hill. Erik ran last because he was carrying his machine, of course.
Luna was sitting in the middle of the field. She was not lost. The cows were.
She had walked all morning to bring three cows back to the right gate, and she was very tired.
That night Luna slept for eleven hours, and nobody asked her to do anything at all.
